name: Kiss yori Saki ni Koi yori Hayaku
original_name: キスよりさきに恋よりはやく
source:
Blue sea and bright sky... Iku comes back to his hometown and starts working as a teacher. However, he doesn't remember any childhood memories. He is back to his hometown after an interval of several years and starts living with Itsuki. Like this, his new life starts...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
蔚蓝大海，明亮天空……郁回到故乡，开始担任教师。然而，他完全不记得童年往事。阔别数年后，他重返故乡，与树共同生活。就这样，他的新生活开始了……

[摘自ErogeShop]
